design.quote: The PREDIMED trial included 7447 high-risk participants.

intervention.quote: Mediterranean diet (with or without wine consumption)
intervention.value: Mediterranean diet (with or without wine consumption)

primary_findings.quote: good compliers (excluding wine), had a multivariable-adjusted hazard ratio (HR) of 0.84 [95% confidence interval (CI) 0.61-1.15] for CVD.
For good compliers with MedDiet (including wine), the HR for CVD was 0.55 (95% CI 0.36-0.83).
For all-cause mortality, MedDiet compliers (excluding wine) had HR of 0.77 (95% CI 0.68-0.87)
which was 0.67 (95% CI 0.57-0.78) for MedDiet compliers (including wine).
for all-cause mortality, the HR was 0.94 (95% CI 0.71-1.26) for MedDiet compliers (excluding wine) and 0.54 (95% CI 0.28-1.04) for MedDiet compliers (including wine).

limitations_stated.quote: Some non-significant associations and interactions advise caution in interpretation of these findings.
limitations_stated.value: Some non-significant associations and interactions advise caution in interpretation of these findings.
